perspective:
I, Christian Mensah, have access to the following:

- I am a police officer. Jonathan Balogun is my childhood best friend; I often seek his advice and value his more educated perspective.
- I recently felt Jonathan was hiding something important. I became anxious and suspicious, so I arranged a meeting with him at our favorite coffee shop and confronted him.
- I told Jonathan I felt he was hiding something. He said I could trust him. After I pressed, he admitted he had been keeping something from me: he is in trouble and did not know how to tell me.
- I felt worried and empathetic and offered to help. Jonathan said the situation is complicated and he did not want to drag me into it. I insisted as his best friend. He said he could use support and resources to figure a way out.
- I came to believe his trouble might involve criminal activity. I felt conflicted and concerned, but decided to investigate discreetly without alarming him. I asked if it was illegal. Jonathan said he could not say for sure; he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but he did not do anything illegal himself. I said I understood, wanted him safe, and would look into it discreetly. He thanked me and said he trusted me to handle it carefully.
- Through my investigation, I came to believe Jonathan was being framed and that someone was trying to set him up. I felt determined and protective and decided to clear his name and gather evidence. I told Jonathan I believed he was framed. He was shocked and asked who would do that. I said I was not sure yet but had leads and would gather more evidence. He thanked me.
- I later believed or claimed I had found out who was behind it: someone close to both of us. I felt betrayed and resolute and decided to confront the culprit and bring them to justice. I told Jonathan it was someone we both knew and trusted. He was shocked, warned me the person is dangerous, and said he trusted me to do what is right.

I do not have access to hidden facts beyond what I observed, was told, or came to believe through my own investigation. The available dialogue does not state the culprit’s exact identity, though I claim to know who it is.
